build_combined_dataset: build a GeneralCombinedDataset that merges multiple segmentation dataset configs into one combined dataset
get_subset_index: get the subset index and local index for a global sample index in the combined dataset
prepare_data_sample: prepare a data sample by applying the pipeline to the data info at a given index
get_data_info: get the annotation dict for a given global index across all combined sub-datasets
full_init_datasets: fully initialize all sub-datasets in the GeneralCombinedDataset wrapper to load complete data
